reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to the Insight by Oak Tree Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to the Insight by Oak Tree Capital. I'm Harry Whitelaw and today we have a special episode featuring Oak Tree co-founder Howard Marx. We'll be taking you inside Oak Tree Conference 2026, playing some exclusive clips from our recent event and getting Howard's takes along the way.

thesis: Howard Marks describes the evolution of credit markets from the 1970s to the present, noting that direct lending has transitioned from a niche market with excess returns to a mainstream, competitive asset class where such premiums have largely disappeared. He explains that Oak Tree's current objective is to find excess returns across a broad spectrum of both liquid and private credit by combining bottom-up fundamental research with dynamic asset allocation based on relative value.
